method: Playwright/Chromium against a static Storybook build of market-chart.stories.tsx (real MarketChart, real overlay pipeline) for the 14 required R_75 M5 states across all 5 required resolutions (70 captures), plus a live Drawing-Inspector-open interaction (real click through the toolbar's Inspect-drawing select, verified to actually open after the §15 z-index fix), plus a live-app structural smoke check across 4 market families.

console_errors.detail: 5 occurrences, all identical: 'net::ERR_INTERNET_DISCONNECTED' for the Google Fonts @import in styles.css (line 1, pre-existing, not a Phase 3 change) during the 1440x900 batch only. This is an external network resource fetch failing in a sandboxed/offline test environment, not an application error -- the app degrades gracefully to fallback fonts and every capture still succeeded with correct layout and content.

checklist.candles_remain_readable: PASS - legible at every resolution, all 14 states
checklist.no_giant_zones: PASS - unchanged from Phase 2's verified 8-14% fill / bounded zone geometry
checklist.no_wall_of_swing_labels: PASS - swings/equal-highs-lows now render as compact markers (§1/§9 fix), not permanent lines
checklist.no_repeated_fvg_labels: PASS - no FVG label duplication observed in any capture
checklist.no_duplicate_lifecycle_prefixes: PASS - unchanged from Phase 2's verified single-prefix labeling
checklist.no_overlapping_right_edge_tags: PASS - 7-tag cap + collision resolver, now stacking correctly above the chart canvas (§15 z-index fix)
checklist.no_clipped_targets: PASS - TP1/TP2 confirmed visible with correct prices in the 14_drawing_inspector_open capture (off-screen bug fixed in §8)
checklist.no_raw_codes_as_primary_text: PASS - WHAT IS MISSING / NEXT ACTION always show pre-translated text; raw codes only appear in collapsed Diagnostics
checklist.no_stale_state_after_switching: PASS - covered by terminal-store.test.ts's existing race/staleness suite, unchanged this phase
checklist.setup_card_and_rail_agree: PASS - verified both statically (drawing-inspector-open capture shows BUY SETUP card + matching rail content) and via the new decision-rail.test.tsx consistency test
checklist.research_only_remains_separate: PASS - research-only-scenario capture confirms 'RESEARCH SCENARIO' label (research-token colored), never 'ACTIVE SETUP'
checklist.live_historical_replay_labels_correct: PASS - toolbar mode badge confirmed LIVE (green)/HISTORICAL (neutral)/REPLAY (purple) across captures; current-price tag confirmed 'DECISION TIME'/'CURRENT' via §17 fix
checklist.no_console_errors: PASS (application-level) - only a pre-existing, sandboxed-network-only external font fetch failure; zero React/application errors across all 70 captures
checklist.no_horizontal_overflow: PASS - confirmed false at every resolution including the new 1024x768

cross_market_smoke_check.jump10_research_only: renders cleanly, zero console errors, new toolbar (Auto-fit/Reset/Diagnostics/density selector/LIVE badge) all present
cross_market_smoke_check.note: URL query params do not auto-select a symbol in this app (a manual UI selection is required) -- this is the identical, pre-existing limitation already documented in the Phase 2 final report, not a Phase 3 regression. This check therefore verifies structural/error-free rendering of the redesigned shell across market families, not full per-market analysis state (that is covered by the backend cross-market regression in checkpoint 29).
